prs.title: fix: PromptFieldVoiceButton overwrites prompt after submit while dictating
prs.author: yihuiliao
prs.body:
**The bug:** If you use the voice transcription feature and click submit before toggling the mic off, the transcription would remain in the PromptField rather than getting cleared on submission.

**The issue:** When the user submits a prompt, it calls the browser's SpeechRecognition.stop() which flips isVoiceListening to false and calls restoreFocus which resets the PromptField to the original contents.

**The fix:** When a user hits submit, we trigger stop() inside the voice button which sets `suppressedRef` to stop recording. This is used as a guard inside of `restoreFocus` to avoid resetting the PromptField to the original contents.
